name: Gallery Illustrator
description: Draws scenes like the Illustrator, but picks up to ten reference pictures from your tagged gallery pool (a face close-up, full body, outfit, location, props) so reference-guided models such as Seedream keep every character's identity. Needs the gallery-reference-pool Engine patch and the Gallery Reference Pool extension.

presets.name: Illustration
presets.description: One polished scene picture with the right references for everyone in it. The default.

presets.name: Selfie
presets.description: An in-character selfie or casual portrait, face reference first.

presets.name: Comic
presets.description: A short comic or manga page with panels and lettering, same references in every panel.

presets.name: Background
presets.description: Places only: an establishing shot with location and style references, no people.

presets.name: Custom
presets.description: Replace the [YOUR INSTRUCTIONS] line with your own rules; references and output keep working.
